name: at-work
description: A pixel-art animation above the prompt that shows what Claude is doing right now, with computer-science jokes on the spinner and holiday decorations; on the desktop and in a terminal

language.title: Language
language.description: The band's words and jokes: auto follows the language of your latest prompt, zh is Chinese, en is English

terminalArt.title: Pixel art in a terminal
terminalArt.description: auto draws the pixel art (14 rows of half-block cells) in a terminal of 34 rows or more and a one-line animation in a smaller one; on draws it wherever the band has 16 rows; off keeps the one-line animation
